shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,140p'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '1,220p'
sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml
cat package.json | sed -n '1,120p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '30,110p'
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix registry test assertion lint" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
